name: @w6w-apps/linear
description: Create and manage Linear issues, comments, projects and labels through its GraphQL API.

w6w.longDescription:
Linear creates and manages issues from a workflow through its GraphQL API — creating, updating, fetching and deleting issues, and adding comments to them, so a process outside Linear can file and track work the same way a person would in the app.

Projects can be created directly, and the reference data a workflow needs to build a well-formed issue — teams, labels, workflow states, users — can each be listed, which matters because Linear scopes most of that data per team rather than treating it as global.

A fit for turning an external event — a bug report, a support escalation, a triaged alert — into a tracked Linear issue, or keeping issue status in sync with progress happening in another system.
